{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Shann_Childsen_HS.png]] |name=Shann Childsen |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], [[Alderaan system]]{{Film|IV}} |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Fair |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' **[[Imperial Officer Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Where are you taking this…thing?|Childsen questions Solo and Skywalker concerning Chewbacca|audio=Thing.flac|}} '''Shann Childsen''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Army|army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Childsen was stationed onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Space station|battle station]], where he worked in [[Detention Block AA-23]]. The Lieutenant was shot by the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] when he and the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] arrived in Block AA-23 to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Prisoner transfer from Cell Block 1138.''"
"''I wasn't notified. I'll have to clear it.|Skywalker attempts to deceive Childsen|}} The [[Gender|male]] [[human]] Shann Childsen{{InsiderCite|170|Terror Test!}} served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Army|army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the war, he held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]][[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] and was stationed on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], a [[battle station]] with the capability to destroy [[planet]]s. Childsen worked on the station's fifth level in [[Detention Block AA-23]], where [[prisoner]]s including [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] were kept in cells, as a [[warden]].{{SWU|set=Spark of Rebellion|cardname=Lieutenant Childsen|link=2855740390|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240317103016/https://swudb.com/card/SOR/035/lieutenant-childsen}} Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], a group arrived on the Death Star hoping to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] Organa. Two of the group, the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] disguised themselves as [[stormtrooper]]s and made their way to Block AA-23 with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]]. As the trio arrived in a [[turbolift]], Childsen questioned the troopers on what they were doing with the Wookiee. The two disguised rescuers attempted to fool Childsen, claiming that they were transferring Chewbacca from Cell Block 1138. Not having been informed of any transfers, Childsen signaled for two Imperial troopers with him to drawn their weapons and then attempted to check the Stormtroopers' claim. Solo and Skywalker, realizing their bluff had failed, opened fire on the Imperials. In the ensuing fight the aspiring Jedi shot and [[Death|killed]] Childsen. The rescuers then managed to successfully free Organa and escape the Death Star. ==Personality and traits== Childsen was a fair-skinned human with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and blue [[eye]]s. He referred to the Wookiee Chewbacca as a "thing" upon seeing the non-human. ==Equipment== Childsen wore a black Imperial [[Clothing|uniform]] including a cap and carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol]]. ==Behind the scenes== Childsen was portrayed uncredited by [[Malcolm Tierney]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].{{InsiderCite|149|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} The character was first named as Shann Childsen in [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] on a card in the ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' set released in [[1996]].{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Lt. Shann Childsen}} The set was established to be part of the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' continuity however, and so not a part of official ''[[Star Wars]]''
